title: Confirm the required audit frequency and publish the FY 2026-27 audit calendar
description: Determine whether example-co (SEBI mid-size RE; stock broker and depository participant) provides internet-based trading (IBT) or algorithmic trading. If it does, CSCRF Sec-4.4 Table 21 requires at least two cyber audits a year, and the value 1 declared in details.json auditCadence.cyberAuditPerYear is too low. Confirm the RBI NBFC middle-layer and CERT-In CCSAPG 13.1.2 minimums (at least one a year, plus an audit before and after every major change). Publish an audit calendar approved by the IT Committee. It must name the CERT-In empanelled auditor, the audit windows, 100 percent coverage of critical systems (at minimum mcp-gateway, which serves the order-routing critical function, and its MongoDB client-data store) and a documented 25 percent sample of non-critical systems (for example db-models). Then raise a human-reviewed commit to company-profile/example-co/details.json that corrects auditCadence.cyberAuditPerYear and vaptPerYear if needed and sets lastCyberAuditAt and lastVaptAt from the Task 1 evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A written determination exists stating whether example-co offers IBT or algorithmic trading and the resulting minimum number of cyber audits per year, citing CSCRF Sec-4.4 Table 21.

An audit calendar approved by the IT Committee (minutes reference recorded) lists each audit window, the auditor and the in-scope systems, with mcp-gateway marked as a critical system and 100 percent critical coverage.

`node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs company-profile/example-co/details.json` exits 0 after the reviewed commit, and auditCadence.cyberAuditPerYear equals the determined minimum, with lastCyberAuditAt and lastVaptAt set or intentionally absent.

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer compares the calendar's in-scope system list with applications/ and with sdlc/metastore.json, checks the IT Committee minutes reference, and confirms that details.json auditCadence matches the written frequency determination. Expected result: all critical systems are covered, the frequency meets or exceeds CSCRF Table 21, and validate-data passes.

rootCause.description: The audit frequency in details.json was declared without checking the IBT/algo trigger in CSCRF Table 21, and no calendar ties the declared cadence to named audit windows and scope.
